Tabular GBDTs require chronological feature scaling and causal shift(+k) rolling features. If R² < 0, check for feature leakage, target inclusion in input matrix, or unscaled predictions.

Prior audit revealed extreme negative R² (-50 to -600) caused by: (1) under-training (<=15 epochs with low lr), (2) evaluating normalized neural outputs against un-inversed raw target scale, (3) prediction std near zero (model collapsing to constant mean).

8,760 hourly points covering full annual cycle. Highly prone to seasonal distribution shift. Validated model selection on 20% validation split is critical prior to final test split evaluation.
